about: Architecture ratchets (refactor plan docs/internal/refactor-plan-2026-10-01.md, stage 0 item 2). Each number is measured from the working tree (never git) and must EQUAL the recorded value: higher fails, lower fails too — lower the baseline in the same commit as the change that reduced it. Retired: localizeOptOuts (infoRaw/reportErrorVerbatim/localizeHints) counted three symbols that no longer exist, so it could never move; the property it stood for, that the output layers print the text they are given, is pinned by advice-matrix.check.ts (info() and reportError write rendered advice un-rewritten).

rawArgvScans.comment: invariant (rf6): membership/prefix scans over argv-like names (argv/args/rawArgv/launchArgv .includes/.indexOf/.find/... , indexOf("--"), startsWith("--, slice(2)) in tools/framework/{entry,integration,core,commands} plus tools/clawforge.ts must be the tokenizer's, an entry seam, or an exempt line recorded with a reason — total counts occurrences including exempt ones, so any new scan fails. 38 -> 37 (rf6-p16): rollback --operation uses the shared path-segment grammar, its own prefix scan is gone. 37 -> 36 (stage 7 S2.2): parseCall and execute.ts's --json probe read the action pick from selectAction (core/command/parse.ts); their own first-word scans are gone. 36 -> 40 (stage 7 S2.4): core/values/kinds.ts arrives (its interval wrapper's message-prefix slice, and the ssh/text leading-dash refusals over one raw value), and the interval wrappers in backup/watch install slice parseInterval's refusal prefix — all one-value refusals, exempted with reasons; schedule.ts's stale exemption is deleted with the flip that removed its line. Back at 36 (stage 7 S2.4, second pass): the dash refusals are expressed without startsWith (raw[0] === "-"), the install wrappers call kinds.ts's shared intervalRangeRefusal (whose own line is slice-based and adds no scan), and the kinds.ts interval wrapper's line is the one exempted occurrence — the same nature schedule.ts's deleted exemption had

tools/framework/integration/gate.ts.reason: the bare-`--` boundary itself (beforeBareDoubleDash/requestsHelp/requestsShortHelp: the one function every help request reads through); splitLeadingAppFlag: the leading --app pair the gate splits off before any command declaration applies; helpWithoutDeployment's first-word test: argv[0] is the command position, an option there is left to the caller; misplacedAppFlag: its fallback for a command whose declarations the entry does not know (the declaration-known path is the tokenizer, differentially pinned by gate-dispatch.check.ts), and the lines that compare the token the tokenizer itself refused (UnknownArgumentError.argument) by equality — whether it sits behind an options-end `--` is tokenizeLenient's answer, not a scan

tools/framework/integration/completion/t.reason: completion's own --app pair skip (the gate's selector, not a command argument); the args.* lines read the registry's declared CommandArgument descriptors, not raw argv; a typed line's meaning (options-end, verbatim tail, pending option) is tokenizeLenient's

prosePins.comment: stage 5 + cross-cutting (I9): checks assert structure, prose lives in goldens; the two added pins in cli-help and gate-dispatch assert the help renderer's own printed output (control-mcp's and remove-app's help) — the allowed renderer-output case. rf6-fix22-B: the added pins (and the matcher/equality growth) assert printed output of the product against independent literals instead of the product's own exported constants — the nearest-interval suggestions of backup/watch install and parseInterval, rollback's refusal and help, the set validate coherent line and the git-init advice — the allowed renderer-output case. rf6-fix23: the measurement widened to single-quoted delimiters (.includes('… …')) — numbers rose because newly measured, not new growth; gate-commands, execute, invocation-hints, init, mcp-project, recipe-new, private-config, private-file. stage 7 S0.5: the independent-expectations conversions were re-expressed as token-array assertions (single-word tokens), so they add no counted pin and the recorded 427 stands.

proseMatchers.comment: stage 5 (design 5.1): prose in other operators — startsWith/endsWith/indexOf of a literal with a space, .match(/… …/), /…\s…/.test(, ===/!== with a literal with a space, includes() splitting a pin across a " + " string join — outside the single-literal pins counted by prosePins; equality: translation must not move a pin into another operator; rf6-fix23: measurement widened to single-quoted delimiters (newly measured, not new growth); rf6-fix25: one fewer — requires-bootstrapped's spaced endsWith("run ./clawforge bootstrap") pin became a structured-advice assertion (renderAdvice(...).endsWith("bootstrap")), so the prose moved into structure; rf6-fix29: two fewer — lock-home's sudo-line collector became one shared regex constant read by all three family blocks (the new spaced-root case adds no new match site); S2.4: the control fragments are phrased so the registry adds no matcher site

proseEquality.comment: stage 5 + cross-cutting (I9): prose as the third argument of check(name, actual, "literal with a space") — a form prosePins (includes only) and proseMatchers (equality operator required) both miss, so rewriting a === pin into check() lowers proseMatchers while the prose stays; equality ratchet: growth fails, the existing sites are not being converted now; rf6-fix23: measurement widened to single-quoted delimiters (newly measured, not new growth); rf6-p16: schema action-scope and interval checks use structural assertions instead of prose equality

proseHeld.comment: MEASUREMENT WIDENING (rf6-fix33), not growth: prose pins HELD IN A CONST — the equality/matcher/pin ratchets above count a literal only at its use site, so a const-held pin, an assert.match(…, /… space…/), an includes(<spaced const>) or a check() array expectation naming one was invisible. Recorded at the newly measured total; the pins are not converted.

ownProductExpectations.comment: stage 7 S0.5 (independent expectations, invariant I11): check()/assert.* assertions whose EXPECTED operand and ACTUAL operand share a symbol imported from tools/framework — one product mutation moves both sides. A predicate argument nested in the actual operand (.includes/.startsWith/.endsWith/.match) counts as the expected role. Initial baseline = the measured state after converting the round 18/19 offender sites to literal expectations (schedule crontab read/update/confirm refusals, host probe evidence and --choices, destroy --confirm-name mismatch, lock reinstall advice, recover-env refusals, system-install unknown-command/no-save lines). Exempt: a file a registered negative control covers (C1-C8, C9, C11), a line marked `// control: <id>`. The baseline was first recorded at 301 with the initial scanner; the measurement was then completed (derived locals, template interpolations, combined imports) and the converted sites moved to token-array assertions, so the recorded total is now 391 (was 301) — a measurement widening of the new ratchet, not growth. A file absent from `files` must not gain one.

frameLawViolations.comment: stage 7 S1.2a frame law (invariant I12, design §7.1, decision O6), re-measured after the law was widened (item 3/6 of refactor-stage7 frame chunks): the law now iterates EVERY clawforge-kind advice row (not 7 selected rows) × every producer × its shells (install/prose/quoting rows paste in all three shells), renders through the producer frame (no setInvocation/frameOf), fills <placeholder> words, resolves the pasted program against the frame cwd, and drives the SELECTION_CASES sweep through resolveCheckoutEntry. MEASUREMENT CORRECTION, not growth: the old total (103) was measured on the 7-row law and misattributed model-defect entries (e.g. quoting drifts caused by rendering under the real host frame instead of the producer frame); the new measurement records the truthful per-case mechanisms. MECHANISM GROUPS and the step that owns each — S1.2b relative spelling (the handed/shim program is spelled from the checkout root whatever directory the frame stands in: 2250 keys, e.g. "checkout gate shim (cwd: docs) | command: status | posix"; plus npm bin backslash spelling pasted in POSIX: 57, e.g. "defaultLaunch: local package (win32) | help prose: restart up | posix"; plus npm-bin re-root fallback note pasted non-posix: 4, e.g. "defaultLaunch: local package (win32) | explicit app: status | cmd") — S1.3 resolver/adapter (hand-set verbatim programs name no resolvable entry: 445, e.g. "manual verbatim (bare word) | command: status | posix"; resolver refusals for rows naming deployments/commands the gate layout lacks: 14+12 run + 16 spawned-gate, e.g. "defaultLaunch: global install | deploy: remote bootstrap command | posix"; gate commands not carrying the handed deployment: 3, e.g. "checkout gate, handed over by the monorepo MCP launcher | refusal: init inside a ClawForge checkout | posix"; the selection sweep: 4, keys prefixed "selection") — S1.4 renderer shell-field (quoting/spelling round-trip drift: 77, e.g. "checkout gate shim (cwd: checkout root) | law: quoting round-trip | cmd") — S1.6 real-shell verification owns emptying this baseline. Ratchet: DECREASING-ONLY — a new key, a total above the recorded, or a changed reason at a recorded key fails; a decrease must lower the total in the same commit.
